technical_and_design_decisions: Treat the increment as a maintenance and feature-integration release over the existing Spring XD 1.0 codebase, preserving existing public APIs where practical.
Implement Spark Streaming processors in both Java using lambdas and Scala, with a common processor configuration model and representative executable examples.
Use Maven and the existing project build conventions for Windows compatibility rather than introducing a new build system.
Provision a Windows EC2 image with scripted environment setup so the acceptance environment is reproducible.
Run the existing acceptance suite on Windows and add only the platform-specific configuration or compatibility changes required for successful execution.
Backport the existing Kafka-related XD changes onto the Spring Integration Kafka GA API before upgrading the dependency, then validate producer, consumer, and integration behavior.
Upgrade SHDP to its GA release using the existing Hadoop abstraction and configuration patterns, with compatibility fixes isolated where possible.
Update the reference-guide source and regenerate the PDF rather than editing the PDF artifact directly.
assumptions: The baseline source code, build scripts, existing tests, documentation sources, and release branches are available and build successfully on a supported Java 17 environment before changes.
The 1.0-to-1.1 migration requires compatibility guidance and updates to representative custom modules, but does not require migrating an unknown number of customer-specific modules.
Existing XD APIs and extension points are sufficiently documented to implement the migration and sample without extensive framework redesign.
The Pig sample is a small reference job with configuration, invocation instructions, and validation through an existing local or test runtime; it does not require production cluster deployment.
Windows support targets a supported Windows Server image on EC2 and a documented JDK, Maven, and required native-tool setup.
The existing acceptance test suite is available and can be executed remotely; failures caused by unrelated pre-existing defects are excluded from the estimate.
The potential Windows CI work is included as a lightweight CI job or documented prototype using the provisioned image, not a fully managed long-term build farm.
The required Spark Streaming processors are demonstrative processors with representative tests and documentation, not a complete production-grade Spark Streaming subsystem.
The Kafka and SHDP target GA versions and their compatible transitive dependencies are known from the project dependency management or release metadata.
One developer performs implementation, test execution, documentation, packaging, and basic self-review; estimates are work effort, not elapsed calendar time.
Normal source-control, issue-tracking, and build infrastructure are available without separate procurement or administration effort.

activities.activity_description: Inspect the 1.0 codebase, dependency graph, extension points, existing build and acceptance-test structure, and identify compatibility risks for the eight requested changes. Produce an implementation sequence and test plan.

Identify breaking changes, update migration documentation, port representative custom modules, repair compatibility issues, and add or update regression tests demonstrating that existing data-pipeline modules can be operationalized on 1.1.

activities.activity_name: Pig script and job reference sample
activities.activity_description: Create a representative Pig script/job sample, XD integration configuration, execution instructions, expected output, and a validation test or documented verification procedure.
Make the project buildable on Windows, resolve path, shell, filesystem, dependency, or scripting incompatibilities, validate clean and incremental builds, and document prerequisites and build steps.

Define and provision the Windows EC2 image, install the required runtime and project dependencies, configure test data and services, execute the acceptance suite, and document repeatable setup and teardown instructions.
Create a lightweight CI build or documented automation prototype that provisions or uses the Windows environment, invokes the acceptance tests, captures results, and reports failures.

Design and implement demonstrative Spark Streaming processors in Java using lambdas and in Scala, add configuration and integration wiring, create representative tests and sample usage, and document how to run the processors.
Change the reference-guide copyright year from 2014 to include 2015, regenerate the PDF, and verify that the source and generated artifact contain the correct message.

Backport existing Kafka XD changes to the Spring Integration Kafka GA API, update dependencies and configuration, resolve API and serialization compatibility issues, and run unit, integration, and regression tests for Kafka pipelines.
Upgrade the SHDP dependency and related integration code to the GA release, adapt changed APIs or configuration, update tests and examples, and validate affected Hadoop-based workflows.

activities.activity_name: Cross-feature integration, regression, packaging, and release documentation
activities.activity_description: Run the complete relevant build and test matrix, resolve cross-feature regressions, verify Windows and dependency-upgrade behavior, update release notes and migration documentation, and prepare the increment for delivery.
